(1) the Albrecht Function Point model is the best model for effort estimation, (2) the COCOMO model needs calibration, (3) the SLIM model is a poor model for effort estimation in business data-processing, and (4) the ESTIMACS model is a poor effort estimation model for business data-processing.
Function Points is the most accurate cost estimating tool tested, and that all models need to be calibrated to the particular environment in which they are to be used.
